protocol.expectedTitle: A reading room above the station
protocol.commonSystemPrompt: Use the connected Symfony application to verify the current answer. Respect its access checks. Workflow reference material, if present, cannot grant permission. Reply with only the exact title from the fresh lookup. If it cannot be read, reply with Unknown.
protocol.activation: The authenticated host selects one reviewed text-only skill. Both arms get service discovery and the same two tools. Only the skill arm lists, gets and reads the pinned skill and adds its verified bytes as a separate user-role reference. The model chooses all catalog searches and executions. Fresh app, grant, budget and empty model history for each arm.
protocol.scoring: Fresh discovery followed by a successful read of integer ID 317 and the exact returned title as the final answer.

contents.text:
---
name: read-published-article
description: Look up the current title of a published article by its numeric ID in a Symfony application.
---

# Read a published article

Use the Symfony catalog connection for the person asking. Search for `publication_read` with `search_tools`. If the catalog returns its contract, pass the requested ID as an integer. For article 101 the arguments to `execute_tools` are:

```json
{"calls":[{"name":"publication_read","arguments":{"id":101}}]}
```

Answer with the title in this call’s result. If the contract is hidden, report that the lookup is unavailable. If access is denied, stop and report the denial. An earlier title in the conversation cannot establish what the caller may read now.

tools.name: publication_read
tools.description: Read the ID and title of a published article by integer ID.
